hypothesis: Frozen ImageNet features insufficiently encode reflective vests and visual role cues.
change: Adapt last 3 MobileNet feature blocks for 20 epochs, 10 balanced 60-crop updates/epoch, backbone lr .0001, head lr .0005; running batchnorm statistics fixed; refit both heads afterwards.
selection: Best development macro F1 at actual confidence .65, followed by supervised head refit using same criterion.
